entries.source:
Mist floated in the pass.
	"This road branches a little further on," @4 said. "To the south it leads towards Eggley and eventually Krondor. To the east, it leads through the Dimwood forest. Which way do you think we should take?"�
entries.translation:
濃霧瀰漫山道之間。
	「再往前一段路，這條路便會分岔，」@4說。「往南通往艾格利，最終抵達克朗多；往東則穿越幽暗林。你們認為我們該走哪條路？」�

entries.source:
The trip was ódull.
	With only the occasional cold draft to chill their bones as they moved through the pass, it was a relief to finally feel the more temperate winds typical to the southern reaches of the Kingdom...�
entries.translation:
這趟旅程ó枯燥乏味。
	穿越山道時，偶爾襲來的寒風凍得他們骨頭發疼，直到終於感受到王國南方特有的溫和暖風，才鬆了口氣…�

entries.source:
They moved east.
	For days they moved in mist, the moisture soaking into their clothes by day and chilling them by night. When at last the mountains sloped downward, the fog lifted and they found themselves standing at the edge of a great wood...�
entries.translation:
他們轉向東方。
	一連數日，他們都在濃霧中前行，白天濕氣浸透衣物，夜裡寒意刺骨。當山勢終於漸漸低緩，霧氣散去，他們發現自己已站在一片大森林的邊緣…�

entries.source:
They turned about.
	In just a few moments they were back on the main road.�
entries.translation:
他們轉身折返。
	不消片刻，便回到了大路上。�

entries.source:
Michel Ambazac
"As you are, I once was. As I am, you will be."�
entries.translation:
米歇爾．安巴薩克
「你如今的模樣，曾是我的模樣；我如今的模樣，終將是你的模樣。」�

entries.source:
Rosel LaMutian
"Her face was sweet and her hands could heal."�
entries.translation:
拉姆特的蘿賽爾
「她容顏溫柔，雙手能治百病。」�

entries.source:
Pargus Attacarper
"His fish didn't get away."�
entries.translation:
帕格斯．阿塔卡珀
「他釣的魚，從未逃脫。」�

entries.source:
Stranger
"His chest was opened by a moredhel."�
entries.translation:
無名氏
「他的胸膛，被莫瑞德人剖開。」�

entries.source:
A. R.Cramond
"He told a lie and paid the price."�
entries.translation:
A．R．克萊蒙
「他說了謊，付出了代價。」�

entries.source:
Klamontala Pechta
"Touched by flames for honor's sake."�
entries.translation:
克拉蒙塔拉．佩克塔
「為了榮譽，命喪烈焰。」�

entries.source:
Goldie Crowe
"In death her face was that of a sovereign."�
entries.translation:
戈蒂．克羅
「死時，她的容顏猶如君王。」�

entries.source:
Hyden Miller
"A bone did him in."�
entries.translation:
海登．米勒
「一根魚骨，要了他的命。」�

entries.source:
Mirriam Haselcalph
"To the Drawer of Nets she took her key."�
entries.translation:
米瑞安．哈索卡夫
「她將鑰匙，交給了收網人。」�

entries.source:
Jad Peebles
"He engaged in his last undertaking."�
entries.translation:
賈德．皮伯斯
「他完成了此生最後一件事。」�

entries.source:
Victor Marmallion
"A cad. A cur. We loved him still."�
entries.translation:
維克多．馬摩利安
「卑鄙如他，無賴如他，我們仍舊愛他。」�

entries.source:
Iruna
"In the wilds was the Hadati woman."�
entries.translation:
伊魯娜
「哈達提女子，長眠荒野。」�

entries.source:
Aglus Soggin
"Another helping put him six feet under."�
entries.translation:
阿格勒斯．索金
「多吃了一口，便入了黃泉。」�

entries.source:
David Bouli
"Buried without a word."�
entries.translation:
大衛．布利
「靜靜長眠，無人多言。」�

entries.source:
Pul Dudding
"No one knew when he came or when he went."�
entries.translation:
普爾．達丁
「無人知曉他何時來，何時去。」�

entries.source:
Ceilia deBuellen
"Water took her to the deeps."�
entries.translation:
西莉亞．德布倫
「水，將她帶往深淵。」�

entries.source:
Baby Irisa
"A week she cried before she slept."�
entries.translation:
嬰兒伊莉莎
「她哭了一週，才安然入睡。」�

entries.source:
A Mother
"Down to night she went, a day before her daughter."�
entries.translation:
一位母親
「她先女兒一日，步入長夜。」�

entries.source:
Ben Snared
"Many were captured by his wit."�
entries.translation:
班．斯奈爾
「多少人，曾被他的機智擄獲。」�

entries.source:
Jake Careoaq
"His drinking days are done."�
entries.translation:
傑克．卡里奧克
「他豪飲的日子，已然終結。」�

entries.source:
Hubert
"We didn't want to hang you."�
entries.translation:
休伯特
「我們，並不想絞死你。」�

entries.source: óThis took some time for them to assemble. I thought perhaps the assassins that had attacked us thus far had followed us through the Inclindel, but there are too many of them, even to chase a renegade like Gorath. Delekhan has to be calling on spies already placed within the Kingdom.�
entries.translation: ó這件事花了他們不少時間才辦妥。我原以為，一路追殺我們的刺客，是跟著我們穿過了因克林德爾山口才追上來，但人數未免太多了——就算是要追捕戈拉斯這樣的叛徒，也用不著這麼多人手。迪勒肯必定是動用了早已安插在王國境內的眼線。�

entries.source: But Delekhan sits in Sar-Sargoth. Word of my escape could only have travelled as we have come...�
entries.translation: 但迪勒肯坐鎮薩薩戈斯，我逃脫的消息，照理說只能跟著我們的腳步一路傳開…�

entries.source: The fact that we have been attacked this far south suggests otherwise...�
entries.translation: 但我們在如此偏南之地便遭到攻擊，這說明事情恐怕並非如此…�

entries.source: I have never been a witness to it, but I have heard of a talent called ómind óspeech. Very few magicians have it, but the ability allows men to communicate over very long distances. Perhaps Delekhan might have hired such help.�
entries.translation: 我從未親眼見過，但曾聽聞一種名為ó心靈ó傳語的異能。極少數法師擁有此術，卻能讓人跨越極遙遠的距離傳遞心聲。或許迪勒肯雇用了這樣的人才。�

entries.source: It is entirely possible. Even before I escaped from his fortress, it was rumored that the magicians with whom he has been keeping company had such talents. I know that his assistant Nago claimed to have such powers, though I never saw evidence of such...�
entries.translation: 這絕非不可能。早在我逃離他的堡壘之前，就有傳言說，與他往來的法師之中，有人擁有這種異能。我知道他的助手納戈曾自稱擁有這種力量，儘管我從未親眼見過證據…�

entries.source: And if Delekhan has the capacity, then undoubtedly he shall use his assistants. So we will have to be cautious and watch out for any who seem like magicians as we head for Krondor. Both of you, keep your eyes open...�
entries.translation: 倘若迪勒肯真有這種能力，他必定會善加利用手下的助手。因此我們在前往克朗多的路上，得多加小心，留意任何看似法師的人。你們兩人，都要保持警覺…�
